**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

- **§ 8.2** — Automatic renewals are **12 months** (no multi-year rollover). Customer may opt out on **30 days' written notice**, meeting our preferred ≤30-day window, and Vendor must send a **60-day renewal reminder**, with the opt-out deadline extended if the reminder is missed.
- **§ 8.3** — Renewal uplifts capped at the **lesser of CPI and 3%**, with 90 days' notice, and **no increase applies to prepaid periods**.
- **§ 8.1** — The three-year master term does not auto-renew and expressly continues only to govern live Order Forms, so it creates no multi-year renewal exposure.

All parameters (renewal length, notice window, reminder, price cap) sit at the preferred position, so no fallback or redline is warranted.
